craft_notes: Sthāyin: confession (forgetting admitted). Abhinavagupta frame: karuṇa-sthāyin with śānta acceptance — the plea asks only absence-ended, not presence-described (deixis thinned exactly where Sanskrit thins: stheyaṃ na bhūyas = no-more-staying-away, no positive image imported). Rows: 1 (optative stheyam kept as plea — ‘let there be’ retained; close lands on ‘away’, absence itself ringing), 7 (tvayā instrumental force → ‘So by You:’ colon landing), 9 (kiṃ kiṃ + vāraṃ vāraṃ both kept doubled). Close: ‘no more staying away’ (absence-reading per L3 note; ‘presence’ close would flip the frozen reading). Rejected: undoubled ‘What has not been done’ — killed: kiṃ kiṃ doubles; softening ‘alas’ — killed: vata IS the admission-gasp; resolving prāsuvatkāyaḥ past L2 — killed: obscure kept neutral. Read aloud: MUCH-time WITH-you has PASSED — a-LAS … WHAT — WHAT has NOT been DONE … YET i for-GET you — NO-more STAY-ing a-WAY.

lines: Much time with You has passed — alas, in this very moment!
What — what has not been done by You for me — for serving the excellent guru!
Again and again I — whose body has reached the peerless divine plane —
yet I forget You — so by You let there be no more staying away.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yātastvatsahavāsato bahutaraḥ kālo vatāsmin kṣaṇe kiṃ kiṃ vā na kṛtaṃ tvayā varagurūpāsānimittena me | vāraṃ vāramahaṃ punarnirupamāṃ divyaṃ bhuvaṃ prāsuvatkāyastvāṃ kila vismarāmi yadataḥ stheyaṃ na bhūyastvayā
notes: prāsuvatkāyaḥ obscure; follows L2’s neutral gloss

reads_against.argmap: Long dwelling-with and total grace received, yet repeated forgetting; the only request is no more absence. → Confession and plea for presence.
